searchText: This already exists, and people mostly used it just for gas tokens not actually cleaning up state. It is largely being removed in London. Someone should propose an ETH sweep transaction that allows people to sweep to zero. We can do that with just a standard transfer, no? Although interestingly EIP-1559 makes it harder to do so, as basefee of the block in which the transactions is mined could be below the max base fee specified in the transaction. You cannot as of London. Well, an expert can, but regular users cannot. By expert here I mean you have to generate the transaction as soon as a block arrives and author it in such a way that it is only viable in the next block. Interesting side-effect. Will ponder. <@!178847887801843712> yeah, that channel is not the right place for that. moving your comment here. > I'm not sure if this is the most appropriate place but I'm currently researching the value of a non-Ethereum chain adopting EVM so that it can deploy Ethereum based smart contracts. > > I had some questions I was hoping if any of you had the answers to, any reading material would also be appreciated! > > - Are there any drawbacks/risks associated with adopting EVM? The only thing I can think of is people still not coming to your chain which would make the time investment / cost investment inefficient. > > - Will non-Ethereum chains that adopted EVM have to change and re-adopt Ewasm after ETH 2.0? If that milestone is for early 2022, I would assume that adopting EVM this late may be less valuable. Thanks <@420951281910284289>, let's hope it does better here hey <@!301186049323958275> / everyone. Ethereum London (currently the largest meetup event in London https://meetup.com/ethereum) is looking to host an online event next Wednesday in celebration of the London hardfork . We are looking for someone (could be several) to talk at the event in a sort of informal chat/discussion based format with some q&a at the end. If you know anyone, would be very interested in chatting more about it. on another note, for anyone around London right now, we are running an NFT gallery in a bar in Shoreditch starting on Friday (with a special London Hardfork event on Saturday), so come down if you are around! https://ethldn.org/ test thread
